tagline: A 2K home camera that keeps recording during load shedding, because the UPS keeps it and your router on.
description: A Wi-Fi camera goes dark in a power cut unless the router stays on too. The Conti mini DC UPS powers your router from its DC port and the Xiaomi C301 camera from its USB port. The C301 records in 2K, turns to cover the room and spots people with AI detection. The 64GB card keeps recording locally.
specs: In the bundle: Xiaomi Smart Camera C301 2K Indoor Camera (R1,549 alone)
In the bundle: Conti 10,000mAh Smart Mini DC UPS (R1,089 alone)
In the bundle: Apacer 64GB microSDHC Memory Card (R369 alone)
Good to know: Set the UPS DC output to match your router (9V or 12V). Run time is shorter than the 3 to 4 hours quoted for a router alone, because the camera shares the battery
